_about: Gold set for evals/run_retrieval_evals.py (cases, error_cases) and evals/run_answer_evals.py (cases with key_facts and exact_facts, plus unanswerable_cases). Each case is pinned to one filing (by fiscal year) so new filings never change the expected answer. A retrieved passage is a hit if it contains any gold snippet (case, whitespace and curly quotes ignored). gold_sections are substrings of the expected section label. Questions are paraphrased on purpose: copying the filing's wording would flatter retrieval. key_facts are graded by the LLM judge; exact_facts are strings checked in code. relevant (optional) lists every distinct passage a complete answer needs, each as a group of alternative snippets; it drives recall@k, precision@k and MAP@k. Cases without it count gold_snippets as their one relevant group.
